title: Copper Mesa: Time Loop Detective

foundation.history: A forgotten abandoned observatory once protected solar mirrors, until recurring dust squalls forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Fen Vale, a chronologist, must prevent a repeat reactor incident, relying on event-order inference despite dust squalls.
central_conflict: a self-reinforcing paradox threatens the abandoned observatory by restricting solar mirrors.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: dust squalls destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: a self-reinforcing paradox contests access to solar mirrors
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
